units: <cite ref="Mishnah Shabbat 8:5">Sabb. VIII, 5</cite> (<cite ref="Shabbat 80b:9">80ᵇ</cite>) <he>ב׳ קלה</he> a light (easily boiling) egg.

senses.gloss: an egg-shaped object, ball, lump. Ib. בֵּיצַת הגיר Ar. (ed. הסיד) cement (lime) in a lump; Tosef. ib. VIII (IX), 20 בזמן שביצה, Var. שהיא כביצה, when it is as compact as a ball, opp. חבוט.—
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Parah 5:6">Par. V, 6</cite>; <cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 23">Lev. R. s. 23</cite>, end <he>ביצת היוצרים</he> the potter’s lump of clay.

senses.gloss: trnsf. germ, root, esp. קעקע ב׳ to stamp out, to exterminate (the last germ). Y. Ab. Zar. IV, 44ᵃ top.
units: <cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 11">Lev. R. s. 11</cite>; Ruth R. (introd.) to I, 2; Esth. R. beg.; v. <cite ref="B00668"><he>בֵּיעָא</he></cite> pl.

senses.gloss: Betsah, name of a Talmudic treatise, beginning with that word (in Tosefta יום טוב).—Pl. בֵּיצִים, בֵּצִים, constr. בֵּיצֵי.
units: <cite ref="Avodah Zarah 3b:8">Ab. Zar. 3ᵇ</cite>; a. e. <he>ביצי כנים</he>, v. <cite ref="K00565"><he>כִּינָּה</he></cite>.—

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Sanhedrin 11:5:4">Y. Snh. XI, 30ᵇ</cite> bot., [read as] <cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 2:5:3">Cant. R. to II, 5</cite> <he>פתפותי בצים הם כאן</he> scrambled eggs are here, i.e. confusion of persons.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Sheviit 5:2:6">Y. Shebi. V, 35ᵈ</cite> bot. <he>עשה ביצים</he> a. <he>עשה ביצה</he> if the leek has formed bulbs. Ib. VII, 37ᵇ bot. <he>ביצי נץ חלב</he>, v. <cite ref="H00978"><he>חַלְבֵּצִין</he></cite>.
